description: Diagnose why an HLS/DASH stream fails on Roku specifically by correlating the evidence you already have. Provide any combination of: the Video node error the device reported (errorInfo, as JSON or pasted log text), the manifest (a url to fetch, or pasted m3u8/mpd content), and a Charles/HAR HTTP capture file. The tool cross-references them into ranked root-cause findings (e.g. "errorCode -6 DRM + a 403 license POST = license server rejected the Roku request"). No Roku device is required for this. Optionally set captureLive=true (with host+password) to deploy a bundled StreamProbe harness and capture the device error first when you do not have errorInfo yet.

captureLive.description: When true and no errorInfo is provided, deploy the bundled StreamProbe harness to the device, play the stream, and capture the error. Requires host+password and a fetchable url.

charlesSessionPath.description: Path to a Charles ".chlsj" (JSON Session File) or ".har" capture on disk. Binary ".chls" is not supported.

content.description: Raw manifest text (m3u8 or mpd) pasted directly, when the URL is not fetchable (auth/token-gated).

drm.description: The DRM configuration you used (helps the live capture and DRM correlation).

errorInfo.description: The Video-node error the device reported. Accepts JSON (e.g. {"errorCode":-6,"errorInfo":{"category":"drm","drmerrcode":13}}) or loose pasted log text.

format.description: Force the manifest format. Auto-detected from content/URL when omitted.

host.description: IP/hostname of the Roku device (only for captureLive).

url.description: URL of the HLS (.m3u8) or DASH (.mpd) manifest to fetch and analyze.

name: roku_diagnose_stream
